description: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE. Eight invented statements labelled with the five canonical claim types (opportunity-ontology-v2.md §7). It exists to prove the evaluation runner, the metrics and the regression comparison work end to end. It measures NOTHING about model quality: the examples were written to be unambiguous, which is the opposite of what a real evaluation set needs. A production claim-classification set requires labelled statements drawn from collected sources, which D-07 blocks.

input.statement: Three hundred and twelve reviews in the dataset mention the export button failing.
The pricing page lists a monthly plan at a fixed amount.
Because complaints cluster around exports and imports, the file pipeline is the weak point.
The reviews and the forum threads describe the same workflow, so they are about one feature.
Demand for this category will keep growing through the next two quarters.
Ship the bulk export first and defer the integrations.
Teams might abandon the tool during onboarding, though nothing collected shows it.
There may be a second audience here; no evidence has been gathered either way.
